description: §5 (S459 L2) — a single-quoted attribute value in a component body (`title='${label}x'`) is E-ATTR-001, exactly as outside a component. Before S459 the component re-parse shredded it into valueless attributes (`<i class="a" title x>`) at exit 0, silently.
rationale: SPEC §5 (S111 quoted-text model): "The attribute quoted-string form is `"`-only (double-quote; single-quote is not an attribute-string delimiter)." Outside a component the same attribute is E-ATTR-001.
